svg.title: Kyoto and Kansai mark evidence
svg.desc: A comparison card separates Ryubundo's documented lid inscription from the unestablished body attribution, Kibundo's published name from uncertain object marks, and Unshikido's current workshop name from an unverified historical sequence.

g.text: Mark evidence: record the part before naming the kettle
Record characters, reading, location, technique, date range, complete-object context,
and confidence. Copied marks and swapped fittings remain possible.
